title: Audit Design System workspace — baseline, gaps, and questions
goal: Audit the Design System area to gather a baseline understanding: what exists today, what the area is trying to build, and what is missing/incomplete/needs improvement. Use deep research and sequential thinking; finish with prioritized questions for the owner to answer on how to build or fix each gap. Focus: shared UI primitives, accessibility, layout, tokens, and interaction consistency

in: docs/engineering/agents/design-system/ — charter, state, architecture, backlog, interfaces, decisions, verification, working set
The design-system default paths declared in WORKING_SET.json
docs/engineering/generated/ — routes, api-routes, components, database-schema, permissions, integrations maps
docs/work-packets/ — existing bounded work packets for this area
.agents/ legacy specialist ledgers that document this area
out: Production code and migration changes (this is a read-only audit)
docs/admin-audit remediation stream unless findings directly affect this domain
Agent registry, task model, and opencode agent definitions

acceptance_criteria: Baseline produced as docs/engineering/agents/design-system/BASELINE.md with current routes, components, services, API routes, database objects, tests, evidence, and intended direction backed by real paths.
Started from the domain working set and a packet built via npm run agents:context -- --task DESIGN-001; evidence-required expansions are recorded in the packet and checkpoint.
Gaps are triaged as missing, incomplete, or improve with evidence and locations.
Prioritized owner questions explain build vs fix vs drop and sequencing.
STATE.md, BACKLOG.md, DECISIONS.md, and VERIFICATION.md reflect the reconciled findings.
No production code or migration files changed.
npm run agents:validate passes with 0 errors before completion.
The task is not blocked on unanswered questions; owner answers become follow-up task records.
